newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end flat ahead of All Saints holiday.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end flat ahead of All Saints holiday.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended flat on Thursday after a listless day's trade ahead of Friday's All Saints' Day public holiday.
The tone was cautious as dealers closed positions ahead of the long weekend and key U.S. payroll data, also due on Friday.
The general index shed 0.16 points, 0.04 percent, to 375.73 and the Ibex fell 2.03 points, 0.05 percent, to 4,306.74.
"The session has been prudent on the part of most dealers," said a trader, adding that this was reflected in low volumes and a thin trading range.

Argentaria limited losses via a large buy order just before the close. The bank ended down 50 pesetas at 5,000 in heavy trade after it posted a 13.1 percent fall in net profit for the nine months to September, well below analyst expectations.
The bank's disappointing results prompted talk of a possible share buyback and restructuring, dealers said.
Other banks were higher, but trade was subdued. BBV added 409 pesetas to 6,200 and Santander rose 10 pesetas to 6,650.
Telefonica continued to retrace part of its large recent gains, ending down 20 pesetas at 2,560.
